excerpt.zh: 这颗行星有着令人难以置信的异乎寻常的美景。这到底是什么样的力量塑造而成的？
excerpt.en: This entire world is unusually picturesque - suspiciously so, perhaps. What forces are at work that could have caused this?

texts.zh: 这颗行星有着令人难以置信的异乎寻常的美景。这到底是什么样的力量塑造而成的？
texts.en: This entire world is unusually picturesque - suspiciously so, perhaps. What forces are at work that could have caused this?

sections.zh: 这颗行星有着令人难以置信的异乎寻常的美景。这到底是什么样的力量塑造而成的？
sections.en: This entire world is unusually picturesque - suspiciously so, perhaps. What forces are at work that could have caused this?

texts.zh:
绝大多数[From.GetName]地表的景观确乎是运用了某种形式的美学设计。我们的科学家猜想即使是星球其余的“处女地”也不过是为了满足一个更广阔的园艺目标而被刻意雕琢成那样的。

在我们进一步的调查过程中，我们碰巧发现了一座信标，这是这整颗星球上唯一一个科技存在的例证。启动这座信标时，它上传了一份包含[From.GetName]上所有动植物品种的目录，以及一个指向邻近的[event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]的参考指针。但仍没有任何用来找到这颗行星的设计者的线索。
texts.en:
Some form of aesthetic design has been employed over most of the surface landscape on [From.GetName]. Our scientists suspect that even the remaining, 'untouched' areas are merely crafted wilderness - there to serve a wider horticultural goal.

Towards the conclusion of our research, we stumbled across a beacon - the sole example of technology on this world. When activated, it uploaded a catalog of every plant and animal species found on [From.GetName], as well as a reference pointer to nearby [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]. No clue was left with which to identify the planet's designers.

texts.zh: 我们在[from.System.GetName]星系发现了一个不寻常的优美星球。这个星球很适合殖民，但是有个问题值得考虑：谁设计了它，为什么这么做？
texts.en: We encountered an unusually picturesque world in the [from.System.GetName] system. It's ideal for colonization, but it seems prudent to ask: who designed it, and why?

texts.zh: [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]的表面上留下了圆形的山脊，优雅地环绕着无数的火山口和山脉。这一设计是否具有什么用意？这里与这个恒星系内的园艺无人机们之间到底有什么关系？
texts.en: Circular ridges have been impressed upon the surface of [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName], sweeping elegantly around its myriad craters and mountains. Is there some purpose to their design? What relation might there be to the Gardening Drones in this system?

texts.zh:
若非庞大的规模以及与[Owner.Capital.GetName]之间遥远的距离，[event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]可能会被误认为是一座我们所建造的禅境。它的地表是一座宏大而风格独特的景观，点缀着无数小至卵石，大如陨星的岩石。我们的学者注意到，其水体与陆地的外观呈现具有一种算术精确性。虽然无碍美观，但其确实偏离了自然的形态，而更像一种刻意的模仿。

无论其来源几何，这颗精心雕琢的星球与最近其表现上涌现的园艺无人机们具有明确的关联。目前为止，追溯它们来源的努力仍未得出任何结果。

也许我们被引到这颗禅境星球是一种暗示，这意味着我们日益增长的问题会在适当的时候被解答。
texts.en:
Were it not for its sheer scale and remoteness from [Owner.Capital.GetName], [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName] might be mistaken for a zen garden of our own making. Its surface is a vast, stylized landscape punctuated with rocks which range in size from small boulders to landed asteroids. Our scholars note an algorithmic precision to its apparent depictions of water and land. It remains decorative, but somehow divorced from natural forms - like a studied imitation.

Whatever its origin, there is a clear link between this sculpted world and the Gardening Drones which recently emerged from its surface. Our attempts to backtrace their origin have, however, yielded no results.

Perhaps our being led to this zen planet is a hint - that answers to our growing stack of questions may reveal themselves in due time.

texts.zh:
[event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]上巨大的几何形式显然不是自然形成的。这颗行星上别具一格的景观是无尽的沙海，上面点缀着无数小至卵石，大如陨星的岩石。

我们的研究院认为，这种景观应该是一种艺术作品，或是一种仪式的产品。然而，唯一可能造成这些的只有我们此前发现的园艺无人机们。目前为止，追溯它们来源的努力仍未得出任何结果。也许只能等待时间给我们答案……
texts.en:
The vast, geometric forms on [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName] are certainly not of natural origin. The planet's stylized landscape is reminiscent of a vast and dusty sea, punctuated with rocks which range in size from small boulders to landed asteroids.

Our researchers conclude that this landscape is likely an art piece, or else is part of some ritual practice - however, the only perpetrators appear to be the Gardening Drones we saw earlier. Our attempts to backtrace their origin have yielded no results. Perhaps time will tell...
